description: Distilled 940-class on-chip GEMM pack. Load as C2HLS_PACKAGED_SKILLS_JSON with PACKAGED_SKILLS_ONLY=1. Not mixed into the 90-skill dump or frozen 20260830_mmflow. Fires only when A, B, C fit on-chip. Not AutoSA / not systolic. ABI is kernel.h, not a hardcoded autosa_mm-only top.

skills.pattern: static-bound GEMM whose A, B, and C working set fits on-chip BRAM/URAM, but compute still reads m_axi or only stages a slice
skills.strategy: Copy all of A and B into local arrays, compute into C_local, store C once. Compute never touches m_axi. If the three matrices do not fit, refuse this pack and keep tiles.
required_steps: estimate bytes of A, B, C at compile-time sizes
if they fit, allocate A_local, B_local, C_local and load A then B in separate loops before compute
do not load DRAM C when gold is C=A·B from zero
if they do not fit, do not complete-partition full matrices
guards: 64x64x64 float fits on U280; 256^3 usually does not
this pack is not a systolic PE array

skills.pattern: on-chip GEMM load/store still walks one float per cycle, or A/B/C share bundle=gmem
skills.strategy: Distinct gmem0/gmem1/gmem2. max_widen_bitwidth=512. LANES=16 for 32-bit. Burst 64, outstanding 16. Keep the narrow data_t* ABI.
required_steps: m_axi A bundle=gmem0, B gmem1, C gmem2, each max_widen_bitwidth=512
TWO loops: load_A then load_B; never load_A_B / never zip A and B in one pipeline
load/store inner loop steps by LANES=16 with UNROLL
target load/store trip ≈ (rows*cols)/16 (~256 for 64x64), not 4096
guards: LANES is AXI packing, not PE_BLK
do not change top pointer types to ap_uint<512>

skills.pattern: C_local RMW or linearized g with i=g>>k / jbase=(g&mask)<<k so HLS cannot prove write-once and holds Final II=4
skills.strategy: Nested affine i / j+=PE_BLK. Assign C_local[row][j0+p] = dot. No old=C_local; C_local=old+dot. No g>>k.
required_steps: compute loop uses row and j0, not a linearized g
write C_local[row][j0+p] = dot once per output
skip load_C
PIPELINE II=1 only after addresses are affine and independent
guards: II=4 with DSP~636 is this bug, not missing PE_BLK
DEPENDENCE inter false is a last resort, not the fix

skills.pattern: PIPELINE only on inner j under sequential i, or PE_BLK=8 so trip stays 512
skills.strategy: One II=1 pipeline over C output groups. Trip = I * (J / PE_BLK). PE_BLK is 16, 32, or 64 after II=1. Budget U280 9024 DSP.
required_steps: for (tile = 0; tile < I * (J / PE_BLK); ++tile) PIPELINE II=1
row = tile / (J/PE_BLK); j0 = (tile % (J/PE_BLK)) * PE_BLK
UNROLL p = 0..PE_BLK-1 independent columns
do not use PE_BLK=8
guards: widening PE_BLK under II=4 does not help
PE_BLK is compute width, not AXI LANES

skills.pattern: K sequential or one float acc += a*b under a claimed II=1 C-output pipeline
skills.strategy: Fully UNROLL k into independent partial sums, then a tree. Do not fold k-slices into one `acc[p] += (a0*b0)+...+(a7*b7)` — that serial FP chain made autosa_mm_hcl_intel 1032/5120 instead of 938/5344.
required_steps: for each PE column, acc0..acc7 over k+=8, UNROLL, then dot=tree(acc0..acc7)
write-once C_local[row][j0+p] = dot
if Final II >> 1 from one dadd, split more independent accs, do not deepen one acc
guards: full K unroll without a tree still II>>1
acc[p] += eight products in one statement is the 1032-class failure
DSP will be thousands; that is intended for this pack, but never above 9024

skills.pattern: unrolled K and PE_BLK without matching ARRAY_PARTITION, so ports serialize
skills.strategy: A_local complete on K. B_local complete (or enough rows for PE_BLK). C_local complete on J for the write group.
required_steps: ARRAY_PARTITION variable=A_local complete dim=2
ARRAY_PARTITION variable=B_local complete dim=0 if budget allows
ARRAY_PARTITION variable=C_local complete dim=2
if util explodes, cyclic factor = PE_BLK / SIMD instead of complete on B
guards: complete 64x64 is a size guard, not a universal rule
never partition the top m_axi ports

skills.pattern: DATAFLOW or tile ping-pong on a full-workspace on-chip GEMM whose compute is already ≈ the 512-bit load window
skills.strategy: Reject ping-pong/DATAFLOW for this pack. LCST with overlapping A/B loads is enough. 940 = max(loadA,loadB)+compute+store. Manual 2-tile ping-pong was 1074.
required_steps: do not emit #pragma HLS DATAFLOW
do not split the 256-trip compute to hide 260-cycle store
keep four sequential pipelines: load A, load B, compute, store C
guards: prompt item 5 ping-pong does not apply to this pack
not AutoSA L1/L2 or mm_pe FIFOs

skills.pattern: one load_A_B / load_AB loop that writes A_loc and B_loc together so csynth prices lockstep II=1 but RTL stalls on either AXI
skills.strategy: Two independent modules: load_A then load_B (nested i / j += LANES). HLS can overlap them. Do not fuse A+B into one trip. The 871/906 fused design is a failure mode, not a target.
required_steps: separate load_A and load_B loops
never name a loop load_A_B or load_AB
never assign A_loc=A[...] and B_loc=B[...] in the same pipeline body
guards: distinct gmem0/gmem1 bundles are not enough if the loads share one loop
csynth of fused A+B can look cheaper than overlapping A/B; do not target that number
skills.template:
// GOOD: load_A_rows / load_A_cols; load_B_rows / load_B_cols; then compute.
// BAD: load_A_B: for (word) { A_loc[...]=A[...]; B_loc[...]=B[...]; }

skills.pattern: on-chip flash rewrite that emits void kernel0, A_t16 host-serialize, L2/L1 FIFOs, or a 16x4 systolic mm_pe chain
skills.strategy: Keep this kernel's ABI from kernel.h (autosa_mm is the 64^3 float example). This pack is a one-shot on-chip GEMM, not AutoSA Design 1/4/5. Do not emit kernel0.
required_steps: top remains the kernel.h extern C name and parameter list
zero kernel0 / A_IO_L2_in / mm_pe fifo_B chain
no K-tiles when A, B, C fit
guards: iso-compute 320 DSP systolic is a different pack
candidate 9 2D mesh is a different pack
skills.template: // Keep kernel.h ABI, e.g. autosa_mm(A[I][K], B[J][K], C[I][J]). Do not emit kernel0.

skills.pattern: csynth DSP above 9024 (small CNN fully unrolled O*I*K*K, or PE_BLK*K on a large GEMM)
skills.strategy: Hard cap 9024. Small CNN: unroll 8 of 16 output channels (~5760 DSP), not all 16 (~11520). Large GEMM: K_TILE so PE_BLK*K_TILE*dsp_per_mac is in [5000, 9024]. 11520/12288/10752 are illegal U280 points.
required_steps: count parallel MACs * dsp_per_mac before emitting UNROLL
if the product would exceed 9024, tile K or unroll a subset of outputs
never complete-partition a reduction that already overshoots the device
guards: U280 has 9024 DSP; a csynth number above that cannot place
float ~5 DSP/MAC, uint16 ~1, uint32/int ~3
skills.template:
// GOOD CNN: unroll oc+=8 of O=16 (~5760 DSP). BAD: unroll all O=16 (~11520).
// GOOD large GEMM: K_TILE=128, PE_BLK=16 int ~6144 DSP. BAD: unroll K=256 complete (~12288).

skills.pattern: uint16 / low-DSP-per-MAC GEMM with PE_BLK=16 and K=64 so csynth DSP stays ~1024, under 5000
skills.strategy: UNROLL ROW_UF output rows in the same II=1 beat. uint16: ROW_UF=8, PE_BLK=16, K=64 → ~8192 DSP. Trip=(I/ROW_UF)*(J/PE_BLK). Do not leave ROW_UF=1.
required_steps: const int ROW_UF = 8 (or the prompt's ROW_UF)
for (tile = 0; tile < (I/ROW_UF)*(J/PE_BLK); ++tile) PIPELINE II=1
UNROLL r=0..ROW_UF-1 and p=0..PE_BLK-1 independent dots with full-K adder tree
guards: PE_BLK=16 times K=64 uint16 is only ~1024 DSP — that is the failure mode
ROW_UF * PE_BLK * K * 1 must stay <= 9024

skills.pattern: K>64 or matrices that do not fit, but the kernel still complete-partitions A[I][K]/B[J][K] and unrolls all of K
skills.strategy: Local buffers cover one K_TILE (64 or 128) times PE_BLK, not the full GEMM. Walk k0 += K_TILE. Accumulate into C_acc. DSP = PE_BLK * K_TILE * dsp_per_mac in [5000, 9024]. Never complete-partition 1024³ arrays (that also empties the LLM: 'no code in translate response').
required_steps: allocate A_tile[I_TILE][K_TILE], B_tile[PE_BLK][K_TILE], C_acc[I_TILE][PE_BLK] only
two loops: load_A_tile then load_B_tile, never fused
k0 += K_TILE; adder-tree over K_TILE; add into C_acc; store C tile after k done
ARRAY_PARTITION complete only the tile, not A[I][K]
guards: 64³ float may keep full K; 208x512x256 int must tile K
do not emit DATAFLOW ping-pong on a 64³ that already fits
